verdict.rationale: MX offers distinct, separately documented products (Instant Account Verification, Account Owner Identification, Account Aggregation, Extended Transaction History, balance, statements) that a developer could choose to integrate individually, implying some product-level scoping, but there is no evidence of a formal consent/permission scoping mechanism, granular OAuth-like scopes, or documented data-minimization controls letting a developer request only specific fields/products at the API/consent layer. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission model documentation, granular consent API or configuration for limiting requested data fields, independent confirmation that products are enforced as separate consent grants rather than bundled under one broad authorization.
